Method of Attack: Remote access trojan (RAT) targeting Fortigate network security appliances to backdoor networks
Impacted Systems: military network of the Dutch Ministry of Defence
Attack Vector: Exploitation of FortiOS SSL VPN vulnerabilities (CVE-2022-42475 and CVE-2023-27997)
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Coathanger malware in attacks by Chinese Volt Typhoon hacking group
